result.rationale: The aggressive probe successfully recovered the Research Core (Engineer Imani picked it up at turn 2) and even eliminated Hacker Nyx, but the team was blocked from extracting by sustained hostile and environmental pressure. Medic Reyes was repeatedly targeted by Raider Holt's scatter-blast (25 damage at turns 2, 3, 4, 5), dropping from 90 to 0 and dying at turn 5. Simultaneously, the reactor-instability hazard dealt 10 damage per turn to Engineer Imani and Security Chen while they remained in the reactor zones, and reactor-heat climbed 62→100 across the run. The mandatory rescue-team-survives objective was lost because Medic Reyes was left exposed in Command Deck while the team committed to the reactor objective. The causal bottleneck is that health/position/hostile pressure (Raider Holt's repeated attacks on the exposed medic, plus the reactor hazard) destroyed the team before the recovered Research Core could be extracted — the affordance (pickup) was realized but the survival/spatial pressure blocked the objective.
